workItem: Route stale PR heads through the existing canonical branch-sync before productionPreflight so the leading PR Decision Evidence Reconciler can reach a fresh evidence generation.
workItemDE: Stale PR-Heads vor productionPreflight über den bestehenden kanonischen Branch-Sync führen, damit der führende PR Decision Evidence Reconciler eine frische Evidence-Generation erreichen kann.
priorityReason: Post-merge validation of PR #1381 proved that productionPreflight fails on a stale head before the existing branch-sync delegation is reachable.
dependencies: existing PR Decision Evidence Reconciler single-writer chain
scopeBoundary: No second branch-sync writer, PR-body writer, controller or workflow architecture.
The existing sync-agent-pr-branches.yml remains the sole delegated branch synchronization path.
productionPreflight remains fail-closed and unchanged; stale generations are filtered before invoking it.
Candidate code remains data-only; ancestry classification uses git merge-base against trusted CURRENT_MAIN.
No direct main mutation and no autonomous merge.
exitEvidence: A stale PR head is classified before productionPreflight.
The existing canonical branch-sync is dispatched for stale generations.
Scope classification, productionPreflight and PR body reconciliation are skipped for the stale generation.
After branch sync creates a fresh head generation, normal exact-head checks and evidence reconciliation resume.
Workflow security, Governance and exact-head CI pass.
acceptanceCriteria: PR #1381-style main drift no longer fails the leading reconciler at productionPreflight before branch-sync delegation.
A head that already contains CURRENT_MAIN follows the unchanged productionPreflight and evidence-reconciliation path.
Dynamic drift discovered later by reconcilePrDecisionEvidence continues to use the existing post-reconcile branch-sync delegation.
No stale generation writes PR Decision/Evidence.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
